comment: Pins for the upstream fastText Common Crawl archives the 9 active models were converted from (per manifest.json). sha256_vec_gz/etag/size_bytes start as null because no .vec files remain locally; the weekly poll (.github/workflows/upstream-poll.yml) records first observations in its job summary only, and reports drift against pinned values. Filling a pin is a deliberate human step; the poll never commits, downloads, or converts.
